display_name: Rollback an in-flight local blue-green swap
description: Plugin-action dispatch returns immediately with {job_id, status: queued}. A single plugin-owned worker performs the operation. Retain the exact job_id and poll service_interface::job_service::get_job until terminal before consuming the result. The former complete response envelope is stored in job.result (status-reader result for reconciliation); failures also retain job.error. Operator-triggered rollback during an in-flight blue-green swap. Plugin-namespace registration backing the service-interface verb service_interface::local_self_deployment_service::swap_rollback. Re-points the router's active color back to the prior color WHILE that color is still inside its drain window (not yet SIGTERM'd by complete_swap). Returns status='rolled_back' on success or 'rollback_not_applicable' if the prior color has already been torn down. Operator-invisible side effect: the in-flight restart_with_manifest's complete_swap durable action will execute against the NEW prior color (green) after rollback. This plugin-action face is asynchronous. The public service_interface::local_self_deployment_service::swap_rollback face and the Python business method remain synchronous and retain their original result on the existing service executor path.
embedding_description: Queue a drain-window router rollback on the plugin worker and return a job handle. Poll the exact id through job_service.get_job before reporting the original rollback outcome. The separate public local_self_deployment_service face retains its synchronous result and executor path.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Immediate receipt: job_id (string), status (queued). The original result described below is available only after job completion. Status, rolled_back_to color (if rolled_back), reason supplied by caller.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Retain job_id; poll service_interface::job_service::get_job until completed/error/cancelled. Do not infer completion from the receipt. Read the former result from the terminal job. Lead with status. If 'rolled_back', surface the rolled_back_to color + reason. If 'rollback_not_applicable', explain — operator needs to know the prior color is gone and recovery is now a fresh restart_with_manifest.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Dependent steps must wait for terminal job.result and then consume job.result.data. Handle terminal errors before continuing.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Operator-triggered rollback of in-flight local blue-green swap.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: router_unavailable: ~/.ananta/runtime/<name>.router.sock not present. rollback_not_applicable is NOT an error — it's a status indicating the rollback window has closed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: If router_unavailable, install via plugins/macos_self_deployment_plugin/src/macos_self_deployment_plugin/blue_green_router/install_router.py and retry. If rollback_not_applicable, dispatch a fresh restart_with_manifest pointing at the desired image to recover.
